cityWatch.label: CITY WATCH
cityWatch.text: BMTC fares have risen by up to 35%; short ordinary-bus trips cost ₹4–₹6 more under the new tariff.

lead.headline: CAB DRIVER HELD AFTER ALLEGED KILLING OF SEVEN RELATIVES
lead.deck: Police say the accused claimed responsibility; one body has been recovered as the search for six others continues
paragraphs: Bengaluru police have arrested a cab driver accused of killing seven members of his wife’s family, including a child. The investigation began after a missing-person complaint led officers to suspect multiple killings.

Police say the accused has claimed responsibility, but investigators are still verifying his account. A seven-year-old boy’s body has been recovered near Nandi Hills; searches continue for the other six victims.
Authorities are examining evidence and whether anyone else was involved. The case has drawn widespread attention across the city as the search and investigation continue.

image.alt: Cab driver accused in the Bengaluru family killings
image.caption: The accused cab driver. Photo: India Today

sidebarStory.headline: BMTC FARES RISE BY UP TO 35% IN BENGALURU
sidebarStory.subhead: The revised fares add as much as ₹12 to ordinary-bus trips, with the state citing rising operating costs
paragraphs: Karnataka has raised fares across its four state-run transport corporations. The average increase is about 33%–35% for BMTC and 23% for the other corporations; ordinary trips in Bengaluru cost ₹4 to ₹6 more for short journeys. The revised fares took effect at midnight on November 5.

groups.ariaLabel: Bengaluru fuel, food safety, and household news

stories.headline: PVR INOX BEVERAGE COUNTER SEALED AFTER VIRAL CUP COMPLAINT
paragraphs: Food-safety officials sealed a soft-drink counter at Forum Mall in Konanakunte after a customer alleged that disposable cups were being reused. The complaint circulated in a video; the company said it was looking into the matter.

stories.headline: STATE FLAGS PETROL SAMPLES WITH ETHANOL ABOVE E20 LIMIT
paragraphs: Karnataka said tests of fuel samples from several districts found ethanol levels above the 20% E20 benchmark, including one sample at 31.2%. The state sought action against oil companies and called for clear disclosure of blend levels to motorists.

stories.headline: BENGALURU CONSULTANT CLOSES ₹43-LAKH EDUCATION LOAN
paragraphs: After eight years of repayments, Bengaluru consultant Arpitha Rao cleared an education loan that had grown from ₹26 lakh to about ₹43 lakh. She took her three-year-old son to the bank for the final closure, describing it as a lesson in financial responsibility.

groups.ariaLabel: India road safety, industry, and railways news

stories.headline: SEVEN, INCLUDING INFANT, KILLED AS TRUCK HITS VILLAGERS
paragraphs: Seven people, including an 11-month-old infant, were killed in Khunti district after a speeding truck struck villagers who had gathered to help a scooterist. A five-year-old child was seriously injured. Police said the truck driver fled and efforts to trace him were underway.

stories.headline: ONE DEAD, SIX INJURED IN FIRE AT OIL INDIA FACILITY
paragraphs: A contractor employee died and six others were injured after a fire during maintenance work at Oil India’s Intermediate Tank Farm in Tengakhat, Dibrugarh district. The company said the fire was brought under control; the cause remains under investigation.

image.alt: Fire at Oil India’s Tengakhat tank farm in Dibrugarh district
image.caption: The fire at Oil India’s tank farm. Photo: ANI

stories.headline: RAILWAYS PLANS DOOR-TO-DOOR PARCEL SERVICE IN BENGALURU
paragraphs: Indian Railways plans to introduce app-based parcel pickup and doorstep delivery in eight cities, including Bengaluru. Logistics partners would handle first- and last-mile delivery; the launch date will follow system testing.

groups.ariaLabel: Karnataka courts, security, and governance news

stories.headline: HIGH COURT QUASHES BJP DEFAMATION CASE AGAINST CONGRESS LEADERS
paragraphs: The Karnataka High Court quashed a criminal defamation case against Chief Minister D K Shivakumar, former chief minister Siddaramaiah and the Congress over 2023 campaign advertisements and posts. The complaint followed the party’s “corruption rate card” campaign targeting the previous BJP government.

stories.headline: NIA TAKES OVER SHIVAMOGGA RADICALISATION CASE
paragraphs: The National Investigation Agency has taken over a Shivamogga case involving alleged Islamic State radicalisation after Karnataka Police invoked the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. The federal agency will lead the investigation.

stories.headline: STATE TO RECLAIM MOST TURF CLUB LAND, LEASE FOUR ACRES
paragraphs: The Cabinet approved a 30-year lease of four acres to Bengaluru Turf Club and plans to take back the balance of the government property for development. The club has asked for more time to relocate, and the state has not made a final decision on its racing operations.

groups.ariaLabel: India cricket and Bengaluru weather news

stories.headline: MOHAMMED SHAMI RETIRES FROM TEST CRICKET
paragraphs: India fast bowler Mohammed Shami has announced his retirement from Test cricket, ending a 64-match career with 229 wickets. He made his debut against the West Indies in 2013 and last played a Test in the 2023 World Test Championship final.

stories.headline: WEEKEND NOTES
listing: Bengaluru forecast: cloudy with light rain

stories.headline: IMD EXPECTS CLOUD AND LIGHT RAIN; NO WARNING TODAY
paragraphs: The India Meteorological Department forecast generally cloudy skies and light rain in Bengaluru on Saturday, with a minimum of 21°C and a maximum of 29°C. No warning is in effect for the city today.
